content: Overview Looking for {{variable.Product_CashNet}} ? You've come to the right place! We officially support {{variable.Product_CashNet}} for {{variable.Product_Events}} checkout only. Let's take a look at what you'll need to configure the {{variable.Product_CashNet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} , prepare a Salesforce org, and configure and enable the gateway. Requirements The names of the APIs used must match exactly what is listed. A dedicated {{variable.Product_CashNet}} site connected to Blackthorn is required to configure Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Events}} to use {{variable.Product_CashNet}} for {{variable.Product_Payments}} . With a properly configured {{variable.Product_CashNet}} site, the following information is required to configure a {{variable.Product_CashNet}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} . {{variable.Field_CashNet_CheckoutName}}   {{variable.Field_CashNet_ItemCode}} {{variable.Field_CashNet_OperatorID}} {{variable.Field_CashNet_Password}}   Prepare your Salesforce Org for Transact (Cashnet)  Add a Transact (Cashnet) Payment Provider {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_AddPaymentProvide}} Create Fields and Update the Payment Gateway Page Layout  {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_AddCustomFieldsPG}} Enable Transact (Cashnet) Payment Gateway Support {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_EnablePGSupport}} Set Up the Checkout Store in Transact (Cashnet)  {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_SetUpCheckoutStor}} Other Helpful Information {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_HelpfulInfo}} How to Test {{snippet.EVST_CashNet_TestPaymentGatewa}}
